changes.title: First death reported in Legionnaires' disease outbreak in New York City
changes.summary: Investigators are still trying to pinpoint the source of the outbreak on Manhattan's Upper East Side that has infected at least 67 people and hospitalized dozens, according to city Health Department data.

changes.title: Michelin-starred Chinese restaurant Yingtao modernizes family recipes
changes.summary: Chef Emily Yuen is putting a modern twist on traditional family recipes from Xi'an, Shanghai and Hong Kong with Yingtao, a Michelin-starred Chinese restaurant in New York City.
